assets.title: Hollow Wooden Boat Shuttle
assets.description: One original static boat-shaped weaving shuttle with tapered blunt ends, a continuously closed thick wooden hull, a real open elongated cavity and a solid flat-bottomed floor. One octagonal side outlet genuinely traverses the thick front wall. Two fixed end seats carry a horizontal spindle, one small cream weft core and one faceted muted-teal wound-yarn form. The internal winding has positive clearances to the wooden side walls and floor; the outlet remains empty and opens into the cavity. Named closed editable components, five constant solid PBR materials, metres, source Z up, long X axis, front -Y and ground-centre origin. The hull and its internal weft assembly count together as one prop. Original boat hull geometry, not a reduced basket, recolored frame or duplicate spool set. No loom, extra bobbin, cloth, loose thread tail or surrounding scene. Static game-art only: no weaving, shuttle motion, yarn release, tension, rotation, disassembly, hand fit, compatibility with any existing loom, manufacture, tool performance or safety guarantee.
